title: Systematic Portfolio Performance: Nov 07, 2025 - May 30, 2026
snippet:
Systematic Portfolio Performance: Nov 07, 2025 - May 30, 2026

portfolio: 21.88%
spy: 12.74%
btc: -28.71%
total2: -28.51%
others: -23.49%

Not the end of the month yet but I have time to kill at the airport and tomorrow I wont.

It’s been a weird 2 months, April through early May, was a bit hard because the crypto market was in this weird limbo where it was emerging from flat to a bit directionally positive, and the short leg took a hit.

The longs were there to smooth it a bit but if I had to point a finger at what happened just from eye balling it, since everything was so weak, I was short higher “quality” stuff and as the market became more favorable, those coins jumped harder off the lows and I took the hit before it shifted out of some of those shorts into a long.

Now the market has been declining a bit and then up, but it seems that the “right” assets to be long and short are clearer, and the portfolio is reflecting that. But this is just my observation I dont have data at hand to show that.

The systems I trade are absolutely having a grand time as of late, and I dont know how long its going to last. In the stuff that I do, most of the time it isnt this good. So I am already bracing for the next sucky period. 

But I am happy that I've been able to perform regardless of conditions, and conditions in crypto have been absolutely horrendous.

I am also running all these trades through various new perp dexes farming their points. Not something I started now, but something

title: took a few days off in Santorini, so taking the opportunity to finish reading Niederrhoffer's book
snippet:
took a few days off in Santorini, so taking the opportunity to finish reading Niederrhoffer's book

you may not agree with his trading style, or risk management, but man reading his book, at some points it's like reading a self reflection in a many different aspects

the book is very interesting, from his weird obsession with checkers even having hired a checkers coach for 15 years, to how he can find commonalities between trading and ancient Greek oracles

and the man could take a punt

having 20x leverage of equity into a single bet for example, which is insane

perhaps why he blew it all up multiple times, but I guess he wouldn't have achieved what he did back then

the good ol question of path vs skill

also you never see him brag about good trades, he just writes from the perspective of the bad trades he took

I do think thats really valuable

I say confidently that I've learned the most through my worst losing periods

I may not have "trades" in the sense that he does like betting against the yen or something but from a systematic perspective I do have lapses of judgement when it comes to punting risk

for example last 10/10, 2024 after the summer of 2023, 2020-2021, etc.

there's multiple defining moments in my own business that I've wrote extensively about that were fundamental to shape what I'm doing today

today I'm most afraid of the things I don't know

I do think I have the risks I know tamed to a level I'm comfortable with, it's the ones i don't that disturb my

few months for end of tax year need to start thinking on cash management for corporate taxes

in PT you have to advance 80%-95% of the previous year tax (2026 in this case) during the following year

so double the tax im going to pay this year

yeh it deducts the following year from profits, but it's still cash off the door that isn't in the portfolio

an abnormal profit year needs careful cash thinking. 

can't go cry to the overlords when you lose it all in january
